title: Reliable Inference in Edge-Cloud Model Cascades via Conformal Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2510.17543v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Edge intelligence enables low-latency inference via compact on-device models, but assuring reliability remains challenging. We study edge-cloud cascades that must preserve conditional coverage: whenever the edge returns a prediction set, it should contain the true label with a user-specified probability, as if produced by the cloud model. We formalize conditional coverage with respect to the cloud predictive distribution, and introduce a conformal alignment-based (CAb) cascading mechanism that certifies this property with user control over the risk level. Our method casts escalation from edge to cloud models as a multiple-hypothesis testing (MHT) problem, tailoring conformal alignment (CA) to select which inputs can be safely handled at the edge. translated_title: 边缘-云模型级联中的可靠推断通过一致性对齐实现
translated_abstract: 边缘智能通过紧凑的端侧设备模型实现低延迟推断，但确保可靠性仍然具有挑战性。我们研究了必须保持条件覆盖率的边缘-云级联系统：每当边缘返回预测集时，它应以用户指定的概率包含真实标签，就像由云模型生成的一样。我们针对云预测分布形式化了条件覆盖率，并引入了一种基于一致性对齐的级联机制，该机制在用户控制风险水平的情况下认证此属性。我们的方法将边缘到云模型的升级问题转化为多重假设检验问题，调整一致性对齐以选择哪些输入可以在边缘安全处理。所提出的CAb模型级联方法在平均边缘决策比例上提供了统计保证，这些决策满足云级条件覆盖率。该过程适用于任意模型架构。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于一致性对齐的级联机制，通过多重假设检验确保边缘-云模型级联中的条件覆盖率，提供统计可靠性保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a conformal alignment-based cascading mechanism that ensures conditional coverage in edge-cloud model cascades via multiple hypothesis testing, offering statistical reliability guarantees.
